descriptionChirho: Aramaic proper gentilic noun Yehudai (יְהוּדַי), referring to the Jewish people or Judeans, used exclusively in the Aramaic portions of Ezra (4:12, 4:23, 5:1, 5:5, 6:7-8, 6:14); the two clusters merely reflect singular vs. articular plural inflections of the same ethnic designation. Translations uniformly render 'the Jews/Judeans': Spanish los judíos, Hindi यहूदियों/यहूदी, Arabic اليَهود, Korean 유다사람들, Swahili Wayahudi.
